text: I'm a web developer in St. Louis. Fourteen years, over a hundred websites, and more than forty-five agency partners.
Your homepage says you craft digital products and human experiences for the AI age. That's exactly the work I want to be doing.
On the build side: custom WordPress themes, private plugins, headless builds and migrations. Fast, clean sites, with back ends clients actually enjoy using.
On the AI side, I'm already there. I build AI workflows end to end: from the website, through Zapier and N-eight-N, into Google Apps.
And since you're a Claude partner, here's a fun fact. I built this entire video with Claude. The motion graphics, the soundtrack, the edit. All of it.
I also love the human part. I'm that rare developer who genuinely likes talking to clients, and keeping people happy is my number one goal.
Ninety percent of your clients come from referrals. That tells me you treat every project like your reputation depends on it. So do I.
Some of my favorite builds started as side projects. A live balloon race tracker. City scavenger hunts. SpookMaps. And a nineties video store, right in the browser.
You work with teams nationwide, and I'm always online. Honestly? I never leave my computer.
You've got twenty-plus bright people on your team. I'd love to make it twenty-plus one.
